layouts.name: Le Mans Bugatti
layouts.description: Closed Bugatti course through Dunlop, La Chapelle, Musée, Garage Vert, Chemin aux Bœufs, Garage Bleu and Raccordement. The 24-hour circuit branches, Porsche Center roads, pit entries/exits and long-lap penalty detour are excluded.

layouts.name: Le Mans Full
layouts.description: Draft course from an independently named OSM circuit relation. Timing variants retain separate catalogue entries; private start/finish GPS is displayed locally.

layouts.name: Maison Blanche 1
layouts.description: Draft route hypothesis: the source cycle is the unique closest nominal-distance match within conservative timing and distance checks. Approximate OSM trace length 2822.6 m. Difference from the supplied layout distance 2.6 m. Course configuration still requires visual review.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap raceway snapshot
sources.evidenceNote: Pinned, sanitized Overpass snapshot. Exact source way versions and slices are recorded in the layout recipes. Geometry comes only from OSM.

sources.title: FIA licensed circuit list, 1 December 2025
sources.evidenceNote: Supports venue and main-circuit identification only. No coordinates are copied or traced from this document. Alternative layout labels follow the named OSM branches and local timing catalogue; they remain drafts.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap named circuit relation
sources.evidenceNote: Circuit identity and exact source-node geometry from a pinned named route relation, including any public-road sections.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap connected course network
sources.evidenceNote: Exact source-node geometry from the pinned country extract. Configuration is a draft match using a private timing position and nominal layout distance.

sources.title: Reusable aerial imagery for estimated road borders
sources.evidenceNote: Derived edge coordinates; reusable imagery evidence: https://www.data.gouv.fr/datasets/bd-ortho-r. Image hashes, extents and extraction evidence are stored in the layout. Estimates remain unreviewed.
